L31·N5540unmasked layer

Rather than a lexical trigger, this neuron tracks local predictability: it fires broadly across ordinary mid-sentence content tokens and peaks on continuations that are hard to anticipate (the "and" in a list, the "let" completing "omelet", a specific number like "60"/"5", " team", a clause-opening " because"), while being strongly suppressed on highly predictable collocation/filler tokens (the "a" in "need a tool"/"as a case study", "online" in "online marketer", "versions" after "earlier").
